description: This file defines a Go struct 'IngressSpecApplyConfiguration' for configuring Kubernetes Ingress specifications declaratively, including methods for building such configurations with chaining.

classes.name: IngressSpecApplyConfiguration
classes.description: A struct representing a declarative configuration for Kubernetes Ingress specifications, including fields for ingress class name, backend, TLS, and rules.

methods.name: IngressSpec
methods.description: Constructor function returning a new pointer to an empty IngressSpecApplyConfiguration.

methods.name: WithIngressClassName
methods.description: Sets the ingress class name in the configuration, enabling method chaining.

methods.name: WithBackend
methods.description: Sets the backend configuration, enabling method chaining.

methods.name: WithTLS
methods.description: Adds TLS configurations to the list, enabling method chaining.

methods.name: WithRules
methods.description: Adds rule configurations to the list, enabling method chaining.
